name: Tendon glides
summary: Move the fingers through straight, hook, fist, tabletop and straight fist positions.
setup: Hold the hand up, fingers straight. Curl into a hook (fingertips to the base of the fingers), then a full fist, then a tabletop (knuckles bent, fingers straight), then a straight fist. Return to straight each time.
why: Finger positions are below what the pose model tracks. Logged by hand.
progression: Add a light stretch at each position.
contraindications: Sharp pain or catching in a finger.

faults.label: Forcing a stiff finger
faults.tip: Glides are about moving the tendons, not stretching. Force makes a stiff hand stiffer.

faults.label: Skipping positions
faults.tip: Each shape glides a different tendon; go through them all.

faults.label: Wrist bending
faults.tip: Keep the wrist neutral so the glide is in the fingers.

faults.label: Not holding each shape
faults.tip: The hold is what glides the tendon through its sheath.

points.t: Straight → hook → fist → tabletop → straight fist.
